description: A gun's rounds go down on the rack as it fires. A bot of one 'fight the rats' step runs a Vexor with one loaded railgun and no drones against a rat off the station's grid. In space the server tells of each shot inside an OnMultiEvent that rides a destiny update, so a page that reads the counts only from a plain OnModuleAttributeChanges keeps the full clip on the rack until the fit is read again (issue 181).
